entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac, agent ID 301. How can I help you today?
Hi Isaac, I need to make a return on an order I placed a little while ago.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have the order number handy?
Yes, it's VF-8675309.
Thank you. Pulling that up now... I see the order is for a TrailBlazer helmet. Is that correct?
That's the one.
Okay. And to make sure I direct this correctly, what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's just a preference. The color wasn't quite what I expected from the pictures online. The box is still unopened, it's exactly as it arrived.
I understand. Let me just check the delivery date here. It looks like this was delivered 59 days ago. One moment while I review our policy.
Okay.
Alright, thank you for your patience. Our policy allows for returns within 90 days of delivery, so you are well within the window. I can go ahead and approve this return for a full refund.
That's great, I appreciate it. Now, I assume I'll have to cover the return shipping cost, right?
Yes, the cost of the return label will be deducted from the refund amount.

I see. Since I do plan on ordering a different helmet immediately—you know, safety is very important and I don't want to ride without one—would you be able to provide a small discount code to offset that return shipping fee? Even 10% would be helpful.

I understand the request, but unfortunately, our policy doesn't allow for goodwill credits or discounts for returns based on a change of preference. I can only process the standard return according to the 90-day policy.
Fair enough, I thought it was worth asking. Please go ahead and start the return process.

Of course. I have just initiated the return in our system. You'll receive an email within the next 15 minutes with the shipping label and instructions. Your reference number for this call is 772-B34. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you for your help, Isaac.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
